snippet.title: Fowl Legacy - Trailer
snippet.description:
Trailer for "Fowl Legacy".

What the cluck?! Ricardo was sent to Hell! It's time for revenge.
Explore different landscapes, jump, run and dash past deadly obstacles, search every corner... and defeat the ultimate evil keeping you from returning to your world!

▼ Fowl Legacy will be released in March 2025 on Steam! Wishlist here: ▼
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3510020/Fowl_Legacy/
